integrity: Proof uses exact formal power series over the rationals; executable finite comparisons are supporting checks, not an infinite proof. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result proves the proposed finite representation for kappa_0 only. It neither settles general kappa_x formulas nor offers new asymptotic bounds. Equivalent unindexed proofs and historical identities not independently inspected remain a literature risk.
title: A proof of the nested-binomial formula for recursive divisor counts
